title: ORDER denying remand; denying PI and oral hearing as moot; imposing 60-day foreclosure notice; retaining MTDs with the magistrate judge
issuing_judge: Hon. Richard W. Story, U.S. District Judge
operative_language: It is ORDERED that Plaintiffs' Motion for Remand [Dkt. 13] is DENIED. It is further ORDERED that Plaintiffs' remaining Motions, namely, Plaintiffs' Motions for Preliminary Injunction [Dkt. 15] and for 'Conditional Oral Hearing ...' [Dkt. 32] are DENIED as MOOT. It is further ORDERED that, should Defendants elect to proceed with foreclosure, Defendants shall provide Plaintiffs (and the Court) with a minimum of 60 days advance notice. It is further ORDERED that, pursuant to the Northern District's Standing Order No. 18-01, Defendants' Motions to Dismiss remain with the Magistrate Judge for report and recommendation along with any other pretrial proceedings.

title: ORDER holding the Complaint a shotgun pleading, directing an amended complaint by 8/21/2026, and denying Docs. 4 and 5 as moot
issuing_judge: Hon. Anna W. Howard, U.S. Magistrate Judge
operative_language: Plaintiffs are DIRECTED to file an amended complaint as discussed above NO LATER THAN AUGUST 21, 2026. The Clerk is DIRECTED to submit this case to the undersigned at the expiration of that deadline. Defendants' motions to dismiss, Docs. 4, 5, are DENIED AS MOOT with leave to seek dismissal of Plaintiffs' anticipated amended complaint or to seek dismissal if Plaintiffs fail to file an amended complaint as directed. Defendants shall answer or otherwise respond to Plaintiffs' amended complaint NO LATER THAN 14 DAYS after it is filed.
notes: 9 pages. Read in full. This is the operative scheduling instrument in the matter.
